questions.question: Sapna invested ₹20,900 on simple interest, partly at 9% per annum and partly at 13% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 3 years, then find the sum invested at 9% per annum (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When interests earned are equal and the time period is the same, the ratio of investments is inversely proportional to their rates.

Ratio of investments = P₁ : P₂ = R₂ : R₁ = 13 : 9

Total parts = 13 + 9 = 22 parts → ₹20,900

1 part → 20,900 ÷ 22 = ₹950

Sum invested at 9% (P₁) = 13 × 950 = ₹12,350

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total investment = ₹20,900

Rate for Part 1 (R₁) = 9% p.a., Rate for Part 2 (R₂) = 13% p.a.

Time period (T) = 3 years for both parts

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 Total Sum: ₹20,900
 
 

 
 
 Part 1 (P1)
 9% p.a. for 3 yrs

 
 Part 2 (P2)
 13% p.a. for 3 yrs
 
 

 

 
 
 Interest 1 = Interest 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the principal invested at 9% be P₁ and at 13% be P₂.

⇒ P₁ + P₂ = 20,900

⇒ According to the question, SI on Part 1 = SI on Part 2

⇒ (P₁ × 9 × 3) ÷ 100 = (P₂ × 13 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ P₁ × 27 = P₂ × 39

⇒ P₁ / P₂ = 39 / 27 = 13 / 9

⇒ Let P₁ = 13x and P₂ = 9x.

⇒ 13x + 9x = 20,900

⇒ 22x = 20,900

⇒ x = 20,900 ÷ 22 = 950

⇒ Sum invested at 9% (P₁) = 13 × 950 = 12,350

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equal Simple Interest Rule

When a sum is divided into multiple parts such that their Simple Interests are equal, the ratio of the principal amounts is P₁ : P₂ : P₃ = 1 / (R₁T₁) : 1 / (R₂T₂) : 1 / (R₃T₃).

Equal Amounts Rule

If a sum is divided such that the final amounts (Principal + SI) after a certain time are equal, the investment ratio is P₁ : P₂ = 1 / (100 + R₁T₁) : 1 / (100 + R₂T₂).

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is always calculated consistently on the initial principal. In Compound Interest, the interest of the previous periods is accumulated with the principal to calculate the new interest.

questions.question: A trader claims to sell vegetables at a profit of 57%, but also dishonestly uses a weight which is 13% less than what is mentioned on it. Find the total percentage of profit earned by the trader. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the base value of the goods be 100.

Claimed Selling Price = 100 + 57 = 157

Actual Cost Price (due to using 13% less weight) = 100 − 13 = 87

Profit = Claimed SP − Actual CP = 157 − 87 = 70

Total Profit % = (70 ÷ 87) × 100 ≈ 80.46% ≈ 80%

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Claimed profit percentage = 57%

Dishonest weight used = 13% less than the marked weight

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = [(Selling Price − Cost Price) ÷ Cost Price] × 100

 Dishonest Dealer Profit Calculation
 
 
 Actual CP: 87
 
 
 Profit: 70
 
 

 Selling Price: 157

 Total Profit % = (70 ÷ 87) × 100 ≈ 80%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the cost price of 1000 g of vegetables be ₹ 1000.

⇒ The trader claims a profit of 57%, so Selling Price (SP) for 1000 g = 1000 + (57% of 1000) = ₹ 1570.

⇒ However, the trader uses a weight 13% less than 1000 g.

⇒ Actual weight given to the customer = 1000 − (13% of 1000) = 1000 − 130 = 870 g.

⇒ The actual Cost Price (CP) incurred by the trader is for the given 870 g = ₹ 870.

⇒ Profit earned by the trader = SP − CP = 1570 − 870 = ₹ 700.

⇒ Total Profit % = (700 ÷ 870) × 100

⇒ Total Profit % = (70 ÷ 87) × 100 = 7000 ÷ 87 ≈ 80.459%

⇒ Rounding off to the nearest whole number gives 80%.

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Formula

When a dealer claims to sell at Cost Price but uses false weight, the true profit percentage is given by: [Error ÷ (True Weight − Error)] × 100.

Combined Effect in Dishonest Dealing

When a trader manipulates both the selling price (mark up) and the weight, calculate the effective Cost Price for the actual quantity given and compare it with the charged Selling Price to find the total profit.

Successive Percentage Change

Alternatively, the net effect of two successive changes of x% and y% can be calculated using the formula: Net % = x + y + (x × y) ÷ 100.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers divides 861616843?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The unit digit of the number 861616843 is 3, which is an odd number.

Thus, it cannot be perfectly divided by an even number (36) or a number ending in zero (50).

We test the first remaining option, 43, by splitting the number: 861616843 = 860000000 + 1616843.

860000000 ÷ 43 = 20000000 (divides exactly).

1616843 ÷ 43 = 37601 (divides exactly).

**∴ The correct answer is 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 861616843

Options = 43, 47, 50, 36

**Calculation:**

⇒ The given number 861616843 ends with an odd digit (3).

⇒ Any number ending with an odd digit cannot be completely divided by an even number or a multiple of 10.

⇒ Therefore, we can immediately eliminate Option 3 (50) and Option 4 (36).

⇒ Let us check divisibility by 43 using standard division.

⇒ First, take the starting digits: 86 ÷ 43 = 2 with a remainder of 0.

⇒ Bring down 161: 161 ÷ 43 = 3 with a remainder of 32.

⇒ Bring down 6 to make 326: 326 ÷ 43 = 7 with a remainder of 25.

⇒ Bring down 8 to make 258: 258 ÷ 43 = 6 with a remainder of 0.

⇒ Bring down 4, which is not divisible by 43, so we add a 0 to the quotient.

⇒ Bring down 3 to make 43: 43 ÷ 43 = 1 with a remainder of 0.

⇒ Combining the quotients gives us exactly 20037601 without any remainder.

⇒ Since the remainder is completely zero, the given number is fully divisible by 43.

**∴ The correct answer is 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 2, 4, and 8

A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even; by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4; and by 8 if its last three digits form a number divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3. It is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

Divisibility Rule of 5 and 10

A number is exactly divisible by 5 if its last digit is either 0 or 5. It is divisible by 10 only if its last digit is 0.

Odd and Even Constraints in Division

An odd number cannot be divided perfectly by any even number. Recognizing this rule allows you to quickly eliminate options in exams without performing extensive calculations.
</p

questions.question: If the 6-digit number N18M05 is divisible by 11, then which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by 11, the difference between the sums of alternating digits must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Alternating sums for the digits of N18M05 are (N + 8 + 0) and (1 + M + 5).

⇒ N + 8 = 1 + M + 5

⇒ N + 8 = M + 6

⇒ M − N = 2

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 6-digit number is N18M05.

The number is perfectly divisible by 11.

**Concept Used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference of the sum of its digits in odd positions and the sum of its digits in even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of digits at odd places (from right) = 5 + M + 1 = M + 6

⇒ Sum of digits at even places (from right) = 0 + 8 + N = N + 8

⇒ Difference = (Sum of even places) − (Sum of odd places)

⇒ Difference = (N + 8) − (M + 6)

⇒ Difference = N − M + 2

For the number to be divisible by 11, we equate the difference to 0 (since equating it to 11 or −11 does not yield relations matching the given options for single-digit numbers).

⇒ N − M + 2 = 0

⇒ M − N = 2

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is perfectly divisible by 3 or 9 if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 3 or 9 respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4

A number is perfectly divisible by 4 if the number formed by its last two digits is divisible by 4.

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is perfectly divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8.
</p

⇒ A rhombus is defined as a quadrilateral where all four sides are of equal length.

⇒ A square is constructed as a quadrilateral where all four sides are equal AND all four internal angles measure exactly 90°.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers divides 814242541?

The last digit of the number 814242541 is 1 (an odd number).

Numbers ending in an odd digit cannot be divided by even numbers, so 8 and 12 are eliminated.

Numbers divisible by 15 must end in 0 or 5, so 15 is also eliminated.

By the method of elimination, the given number must be divisible by 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Number = 814242541

**Calculations:**

Let us check the divisibility rule for 7 directly.

Rule for 7: Form groups of 3 digits starting from the rightmost digit. The difference between the sum of odd-positioned groups and even-positioned groups must be divisible by 7.

⇒ Groups of three digits from right to left: 541, 424, 814

⇒ Sum of odd-positioned groups = 541 + 814 = 1355

⇒ Sum of even-positioned groups = 424

⇒ Difference = 1355 − 424 = 931

⇒ Checking divisibility of 931 by 7: 931 ÷ 7 = 133

⇒ Since 931 is exactly divisible by 7, the entire number 814242541 is also divisible by 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 7, 11, and 13

Form groups of 3 digits from right to left. Find the difference between the sum of odd-placed groups and even-placed groups. If the difference is divisible by 7, 11, or 13, then the original number is divisible by 7, 11, or 13 respectively.

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is a multiple of 8.

Divisibility Rule of 12

A number is divisible by 12 if it is divisible by both 3 and 4.

Divisibility Rule of 15

A number is divisible by 15 if it is divisible by both 3 and 5. This means it must end in 0 or 5 and the sum of its digits must be a multiple of 3.

questions.question: The product of two consecutive natural numbers is 702. The greater of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The product of two consecutive numbers x and (x + 1) is approximately equal to x².

We know the squares of nearby numbers: 26² = 676 and 27² = 729.

The given product 702 lies perfectly between 676 and 729, meaning the numbers are 26 and 27.

Checking the product directly: 26 × 27 = 702.

Hence, the greater of the two numbers is 27.

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The product of two consecutive natural numbers = 702

**Calculation:**

Let the smaller natural number be n.

Then, the greater consecutive natural number will be (n + 1).

⇒ n × (n + 1) = 702

⇒ n² + n = 702

⇒ n² + n − 702 = 0

⇒ n² + 27n − 26n − 702 = 0

⇒ n(n + 27) − 26(n + 27) = 0

⇒ (n − 26)(n + 27) = 0

⇒ n = 26 or n = −27

Since n must be a natural number, it cannot be a negative value.

⇒ n = 26

The greater number = n + 1

⇒ 26 + 1 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Numbers

Numbers that follow each other continuously in order from smallest to largest, with a common difference of 1. They are generally represented as n, n+1, n+2, etc.

Consecutive Even or Odd Numbers

These numbers skip one integer, meaning they always maintain a difference of 2. They are represented as 2n, 2n+2 for even numbers, and 2n+1, 2n+3 for odd numbers.

Quadratic Equation Roots

For a quadratic equation in the form ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is given by (−b ÷ a) and the product of roots is given by (c ÷ a).
</p

⇒ LCM = 12.8

**∴ The correct answer is 12.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF of Decimals

Make the decimal places equal, find the HCF of the numbers as integers, and place the decimal point back.

HCF of Fractions

HCF = HCF of numerators ÷ LCM of denominators.

Product of Two Numbers

For any two numbers A and B: LCM(A, B) × HCF(A, B) = A × B.

Simplification of Fractions

Always convert decimal numbers to their simplest fractional forms before applying the LCM or HCF formulas to avoid calculation errors.
</p

questions.question: A retailer offers the following discount scheme to his customers for the purchase of articles. 'Buy 30 and get 10 free' Find the discount percentage offered.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 'Buy X Get Y Free' schemes, the discount percentage is calculated on the total items given.

Discount % = [Free Items ÷ Total Items] × 100

⇒ Discount % = [10 ÷ (30 + 10)] × 100

⇒ Discount % = (10 ÷ 40) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of articles bought (Paid) = 30

Number of free articles (Discount) = 10

 

 Total = 40 Items (Marked Price Base)
 
 
 30 Items Paid
 10 Free
 

 Discount
 Discount % = (10 ÷ 40) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Marked Price (MP) of 1 article be 1 unit.

⇒ Total articles taken by the customer = 30 + 10 = 40.

⇒ Total Marked Price (MP) = 40 units.

⇒ Total Selling Price (SP) = 30 units (since the customer pays for 30 articles only).

⇒ Discount = Total MP − Total SP

⇒ Discount = 40 − 30 = 10 units.

⇒ Discount Percentage = (Discount ÷ Total MP) × 100

⇒ Discount Percentage = (10 ÷ 40) × 100

⇒ Discount Percentage = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Buy X Get Y Free Rule

In any scheme offering free articles, the discount is always calculated on the total number of articles the customer takes home. Discount % = [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100.

Marked Price vs Cost Price

Marked price is the price printed on an article. Discount is always evaluated on the Marked Price (MP) unless specified otherwise. Discount = MP − SP.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the equivalent single discount is given by the formula: [a + b − (a × b ÷ 100)]%.
</p

questions.question: Find the value of x satisfying: 5(2x2 - 7) - 2(5x2 + 8x - 2) = 12
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the brackets directly to cancel out the x² terms:

⇒ 10x² − 35 − 10x² − 16x + 4 = 12

⇒ −16x − 31 = 12

⇒ −16x = 43 → x = −43/16

**∴ The correct answer is −(43)/(16).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5(2x² − 7) − 2(5x² + 8x − 2) = 12

**Calculation:**

⇒ Apply the distributive property to expand the terms.

⇒ 5 × 2x² − 5 × 7 − 2 × 5x² − 2 × 8x − 2 × (−2) = 12

⇒ 10x² − 35 − 10x² − 16x + 4 = 12

⇒ Group the like terms together.

⇒ (10x² − 10x²) − 16x − 35 + 4 = 12

⇒ 0 − 16x − 31 = 12

⇒ −16x = 12 + 31

⇒ −16x = 43

⇒ x = −43 / 16

**∴ The correct answer is −(43)/(16).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the correct sequence of steps to solve mathematical expressions: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Distributive Property

It states that multiplying a sum by a number gives the same result as multiplying each addend by the number and then adding the products: a(b + c) = ab + ac.

Linear Equation

An equation where the highest power of the variable is 1. When the higher powers (like x²) cancel out, the equation reduces to a simple linear form.
</p

questions.question: ₹12,300 were divided among A, B and C such that 3 times the share of A = 6 times the share of B = 2 times the share of C. Find the share of A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given 3A = 6B = 2C. Find their direct ratio by dividing the LCM of coefficients (6) by each coefficient.

Ratio A : B : C = 6/3 : 6/6 : 6/2 = 2 : 1 : 3.

Total ratio parts = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 parts.

A's share = (2 ÷ 6) × 12300 = ₹4,100.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount to be divided = ₹12,300

3 × A's share = 6 × B's share = 2 × C's share

 

 Total Sum = ₹12,300 (6 parts)

 
 A : 2 parts

 
 B : 1 part

 
 C : 3 parts

 

 A's Share = ?
 
 1 part = ₹12,300 ÷ 6 = ₹2,050
 A's share = 2 × 2050 = ₹4,100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let 3A = 6B = 2C = k

⇒ A = k/3, B = k/6, C = k/2

⇒ Ratio of shares A : B : C = 1/3 : 1/6 : 1/2

⇒ Multiplying by the LCM of denominators (3, 6, 2) which is 6:

⇒ A : B : C = (1/3 × 6) : (1/6 × 6) : (1/2 × 6)

⇒ A : B : C = 2 : 1 : 3

⇒ Sum of the ratio parts = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 parts

⇒ 6 parts = ₹12,300

⇒ 1 part = 12300 ÷ 6 = ₹2,050

⇒ Share of A = 2 parts = 2 × 2050 = ₹4,100

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied term by term, the result is a compound ratio. For a:b and c:d, the compound ratio is ac:bd.

Duplicate & Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is a²:b² and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a:√b.

Proportion Rule

If a:b :: c:d, then Product of Extremes = Product of Means, i.e., a × d = b × c.
</p

questions.question: Find the value of 50-6 ÷ 5018 × 50-5
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For expressions with identical bases, multiplication adds the exponents and division subtracts the exponents.

Given expression: 50⁻⁶ ÷ 50¹⁸ × 50⁻⁵

Directly combine the exponents: -6 − 18 + (-5) = -29

Result = 50⁻²⁹

**∴ The correct answer is 50⁻²⁹.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

50⁻⁶ ÷ 50¹⁸ × 50⁻⁵

**Formula Used:**

am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ (50⁻⁶ ÷ 50¹⁸) × 50⁻⁵

⇒ 50⁻⁶ − ¹⁸ × 50⁻⁵

⇒ 50⁻²⁴ × 50⁻⁵

⇒ 50⁻²⁴ ⁺ ⁽⁻⁵⁾

⇒ 50⁻²⁹

**∴ The correct answer is 50⁻²⁹.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule for Exponents

When multiplying expressions with the same base, you add the exponents together: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ.

Quotient Rule for Exponents

When dividing expressions with the same base, you subtract the exponents: am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ.

Power of a Power Rule

When raising a power to another power, you multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ.

Negative Exponent Rule

A negative exponent indicates the reciprocal of the base raised to the positive exponent: a⁻ⁿ = 1 ÷ aⁿ.
</p

questions.question: Find the median of 26, 13, 14, 15, 8, 36, 23, 35 and 50
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an odd number of observations, sort the sequence and pick the exact middle value.

Ascending order: 8, 13, 14, 15, **23**, 26, 35, 36, 50.

The total terms are 9, so the middle term is the 5th one.

The 5th term is 23.

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 26, 13, 14, 15, 8, 36, 23, 35, 50

Total number of terms (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

If n is odd, Median = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term of the sorted data.

 Sorted Data Set
 
 
 8

 
 13

 
 14

 
 15

 
 23

 
 26

 
 35

 
 36

 
 50

 

 Median = 5th Term

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arranging data in ascending order: 8, 13, 14, 15, 23, 26, 35, 36, 50

⇒ Median position = (n + 1) ÷ 2

⇒ Median position = (9 + 1) ÷ 2 = 10 ÷ 2

⇒ Median position = 5th term

⇒ From the sorted data set, the 5th term is 23.

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The arithmetic average of all observations. Formula: Mean = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Mode

The value that occurs most frequently in the given data set.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is defined as: Mode ≈ 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
</p
